content.text:
**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred level) — no redline.**

Cobalt Cloud's § 18 already satisfies every preferred INSURANCE element:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M per occurrence | § 18.1 |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | § 18.1 |
| E&O USD 2M | § 18.1 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M where Customer Data processed | § 18.1 (granted unconditionally — broader than required) |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | § 18.1 |
| Certificates on request | § 18.2 ("On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance…") |

Extras (employer's liability USD 1M, one-year tail, primary coverage, cancellation notice, and "Insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities") all run in our favour, so nothing to negotiate here.
